subject: Genetics
title: Chromatin Remodeling
description: Learn Chromatin Remodeling in one minute.

hook.text: Chromatin remodelers are molecular machines that grab nucleosomes and slide, eject, or swap them.

buildup.text: DNA tightly wound into chromatin is invisible to the cell's reading machinery.

discovery.text: The SWI/SNF complex uses ATP energy to shove nucleosomes aside, exposing DNA for transcription.

twist.text: SWI/SNF mutations appear in 20% of all human cancers.

climax.text: Chromatin remodeling is dynamic. Genes can flip from silent to active in minutes.

punchline.text: Molecular bulldozers decide which genes see daylight.

quiz.question: What does the SWI/SNF complex do?
